data.name: Jilani
data.gender_notes: Jilani is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'jilana' which means 'to flow' or 'to be gentle'. In Islamic tradition, Jilani refers to someone who is gentle, gracious, and kind. The name Jilani carries the meaning “Gentle, gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jilani usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for someone who is a source of blessings and inspiration
data.etymology: Jilani belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jilani total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: جيلاني
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جَلَنَ يَجْلِنُ جَلينا وهو اسم الفاعل من جَلِىَ
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم العلم جيلاني مشتق من الجذر اللغوي جَلَنَ، ومن الفعل جَلِىَ يَجْلَى جَلاءً، ويعني الظهور والانفراج. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَيَجْعَلُ مِنكُم مَّن يَرِثُكُم وَيَجْعَلُ مِنكُم مَّن يَأْخُذُكُمْ كَمَثَلِ جِلٍ أَخَذَ رُذُولاً' (الأنعام: 6: 98). ويحمل الاسم دلالات روحية عميقة تتعلق بالانفراج والفرج الإلهي.

in_urdu.name: جیلانی
in_urdu.meaning: نام جیلانی جَلَنَ سے ماخوذ ہے، معنی ظاہر ہونے والا، انکشاف پانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: جیلانی نام عربی جڑ جَلَنَ سے نکلا ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں ظاہر ہونا، واضح ہونا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ انبیاء اور صالحین کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے۔ جیلانی نام کے حامل کو خوش قسمت اور انکے مستقبل میں اچھے امکانات مانے جاتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: जिलानी
in_hindi.meaning: जिलानी नाम का अर्थ है जो कुछ छुपा हुआ था वह दिख जाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिलानी नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है कुछ छुपा हुआ दिखाना या स्पष्ट होना। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है और इसे पवित्र माना जाता है। जो लोग इस नाम को धारण करते हैं, उन्हें भाग्यशाली और उच्च आत्मा वाला माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: جلاني
in_pashto.meaning: جلاني د (جَلَنَ) د ريښې څخه اخستل شوی، مانې يې ظاهریدونکی، ښکاره شوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: جلاني نوم د عربي ريښې جَلَنَ څخه اخستل شوی دی، چي معنی يې د ظاہریدونکي یا ښکاره شوي څخه عبارت دي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په ميان کې د يو ښه او خوشحاله نوم په توګه ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Jilani
in_english.meaning: Jilani means 'one who appears or becomes clear'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jilani is derived from the Arabic root 'جَلَنَ' (jalana), which means 'to appear' or 'to become clear'. It is a significant name in Islamic tradition, symbolizing clarity, revelation, and spiritual enlightenment. The name is associated with positive attributes such as wisdom, insight, and illumination.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jilani holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world. It is a popular name for both males and females in the Muslim community. The gentle and gracious nature of the name resonates with the fundamental teachings of Islam which emphasize kindness, compassion, and respect for all living beings. The name Jilani is often associated with saints and scholars who embody these virtues and have made significant contributions to Islamic thought and practice.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jilani holds great significance in Sufism, the mystical branch of Islam. The name is especially associated with the prominent Sufi saint and scholar, Shahabuddin Suhrawardi, who is also known as Shaikh Abdul Qadir Jilani. He is considered one of the most influential Sufis in Islamic history and is revered for his profound wisdom, deep spiritual insights, and extraordinary piety. The gentle and flowing nature of the name Jilani reflects the inner spiritual journey of the seeker, who aims to purify the heart, seek the companionship of Allah, and cultivate love, compassion, and kindness towards all creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Jilani is derived from the Arabic word 'jalana' meaning 'he appeared'. In Sufism, it is associated with the revered saint, Imam Al-Junaid Al-Baghdadi, whose spiritual appearance brought light and guidance to countless seekers. Thus, Jilani symbolizes the divine presence that illuminates the spiritual journey of individuals.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Jilani is of Islamic origin and translates to 'sea' or 'ocean'. It is most commonly associated with the Sufi saint, Al-Hajj Muhammad ibn Yusuf al-Jilani, who is revered for his piety and miraculous abilities. His followers and devotees frequently use the name Jilani as a mark of respect and admiration. The name is also used to describe individuals with mystical or healing qualities. On social media platforms such as Twitter, Instagram, and Reddit, you may find hashtags, groups, and discussions dedicated to Al-Hajj Muhammad ibn Yusuf al-Jilani, Sufi teachings, and spiritual healing practices. The use of the name Jilani in modern contexts often reflects a deep appreciation for Islamic spirituality, Sufi mysticism, and the pursuit of inner peace and enlightenment.
